id: title:TueHaulund:drain in flight http requests before closing the node server

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HTTP server connection draining configuration and connection tracking, supporting graceful shutdown and resource cleanup for PostHog's backend HTTP services.
review.reason: Adds a configuration option for HTTP connection draining and a counter to track open connections, with a UWS filter implementation to support this behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement to connection management and graceful shutdown handling.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the drainConnections method, the definition of the openConnections counter, or the UWS filter registration, so the complete behavior and its effectiveness cannot be verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the `drainConnections` method, the definition of the `openConnections` counter, or the UWS filter registration. The chunk P1.F3.H5 adds the `drainConnections` method and its call, P1.F3.H3 adds the UWS filter, P1.F3.H4 adds the call, P1.F3.H2 adds the field, P1.F3.H3 adds the config. P1.F3.H5 adds the method. P1.F3.H3 adds the UWS.
